invited: A kpọrọ gị òkù ka ị sonye n'Otu
invitedBody: Ṅụọnụ mmiri ọnụ ma gbaanụ ibe unu ume. Mepee ngwa ahụ ka ị sonye, ma ọ bụ pịnye koodu a n'okpuru Otu.
noApp: Ị nwebeghị ngwa ahụ? The Water Check na-abịa na App Store na Google Play. Ozugbo i nwetara ya, mepee njikọ a ọzọ ma ọ bụ jiri koodu ahụ sonye.
incompleteBody: Rịọ enyi gị ka o zigharịa òkù ahụ, ma ọ bụ jiri koodu o zitere gị sonye n'okpuru Otu na ngwa ahụ.
